runs.name: tag
runs.command: thinkthen tag 'Which labels fit this message?' praise bug billing < message.txt
runs.input:
Love the new dashboard, but export crashes the app,
and I was charged twice.
runs.see: The message praises the dashboard, reports a crash, and names a double charge, so it gets praise, bug, and billing.

runs.name: tag-answer
runs.command: thinkthen tag --details 'Which labels fit this message?' praise bug billing < message.txt | jq '.answer.probabilities'
runs.input:
Love the new dashboard, but export crashes the app,
and I was charged twice.
runs.see: praise, bug, and billing each clear 0.5.

runs.name: tag-labels
runs.command: thinkthen tag --lines --threshold 0.9 'Which labels fit this message?' --label 'bug=Something is broken.' --label 'praise=Says something kind.' --label 'request=Asks for something new.' < feedback.txt | jq -r '"\(.value | join(","))  \(.input)"'
runs.input:
The export button crashes the app.
Great support, thank you!
Please add a dark mode.
runs.output:
bug  The export button crashes the app.
praise  Great support, thank you!
request  Please add a dark mode.
runs.see: Each line gets the one label its description fits.
